basic_details.job_title: NeGD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Full Stack Developer, Business Analyst Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD), an independent business division of Digital India Corporation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, has invited applications for one Full Stack (AI) Developer and one Business Analyst (Tech BA) on a contractual basis for a period of three years. Applications are accepted online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ until 25 November 2026. The qualification is B.E/B. Tech./ MCA for the developer post and B.E/ B. Tech/M.Tech/MBA for the Business Analyst post, with 4–6 years and 5+ years of experience respectively; the maximu

how_to_apply: The notice asks eligible candidates to apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ by 25.11.2026. It does not describe the steps inside the portal. The full details are stated to be available on www.negd.gov.in, www.dic.gov.in and www.meity.gov.in.

A No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies. Such candidates are expected to apply through proper channel, or attach the certificate with the application, or produce it at the time of interview.
important_instructions: The engagement is on a contractual basis for a period of three years. The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of NeGD/DIC. Appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC or on any vacancies existing or advertised in future. NeGD reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason. NeGD reserves the right to terminate the appointments with a notice of one month, or without any notice by paying one month's salary in lieu of the notice period. The designation of selected candidates will be mapped as per the existing designation policy of NeGD. For queries, contact the HR Team, National e-Governance Division, 4th Floor, Electronics Niketan, 6 CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003, Email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About National e-Governance Division
content_sections.text: NeGD was set up by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology as an Independent Business Division under Digital India Corporation (erstwhile Media Lab Asia). Its work covers programme management, project development, technology management, capacity building and awareness activities under the Digital India Programme. It develops and manages national platforms such as DigiLocker, UMANG, OpenForge, API Setu and MyScheme.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 2 posts in total. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: 4–6 years of experience in the IT industry, with strong hands-on experience in full-stack application development using Angular, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and NestJS. Proficient in developing scalable backend applications, RESTful APIs, microservices, and server-side business logic using Node.js and its frameworks. Hands-on experience with Angular/React JavaScript frameworks, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices. Working knowledge of backend architectures, database design, application scalability, performance optimization, and emerging technologies. Strong understanding of AI/Generative AI, LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architecture, vector databases, embeddings, AI agents, and multi-model integrations. Knowledge of JSON Web Tokens (JWT), OAuth2 and secure API development; proficient understanding of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL; hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies. 5+ years in software/IT project delivery, including at least 3 years as a Business Analyst or Techno-functional lead on enterprise or citizen-facing system integration/implementation projects. Working knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP, JSON), databases (SQL) and the software development lifecycle; able to read API specifications (Swagger/OpenAPI). Proficient in MS Office, MS Project and JIRA (or equivalent); hands-on experience writing BRD/FRS, user stories and UAT test cases. Hands-on experience with Agile development methods (sprint planning, backlog grooming, UAT cycles). Proven stakeholder management and coordination with government officials and multiple vendor/partner agencies. Strong written and verbal communication (English and Hindi); must be AI ready; expert in MS Word, Excel, PPT; extensive working knowledge of API, its collections, postman, endpoints and encrypted responses. Age limit for both posts: the maximum age limit is 45 years on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Strong experience in Angular and React.js for developing dynamic, responsive, scalable, and high-performance web applications. Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend development practices. Strong backend development experience with Node.js, Express.js, and NestJS, including REST API development, microservices, and server-side architecture. Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, database design, complex queries, indexing, optimization, and ORM tools. Experience in designing and integrating RESTful APIs, third-party services, authentication, authorization, JWT, and secure application architectures. Hands-on experience with AI/Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including integration of OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar models. Good understanding of LangChain and LangGraph, including AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, and multi-model integration. Strong understanding of RAG architecture, including embeddings, vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, etc.), semantic search, document processing, chunking, and retrieval strategies. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Agile/Scrum, automated testing, code reviews, deployment, and application performance optimization. Ability to independently design, develop, integrate, and deliver end-to-end full-stack and AI-powered applications, with minimal supervision and strong problem-solving skills. The job holder will own end-to-end onboarding of Central/State department services on UMANG (requirement capture, integration coordination, UAT and go-live). After go-live, the job holder will monitor and ensure that these services run smoothly within agreed SLAs, including day-to-day monitoring of UMANG services and restoring services quickly with clear status updates to higher authorities. On Boarding Build relationships with nodal officers of Central/State departments to identify and prioritise services for UMANG; obtain formal onboarding requests and coordinate with government officials and vendors to take services live. Prepare API document, BRD, FRS, UML, DFDs, wireframe, process flow and user stories, and obtain department sign-off before development starts. Review the department's API specifications and integration design with the technical team, and confirm the go-live checklist (sandbox testing, UAT sign-off, security audit, hosting readiness, app-store listing). Maintain an onboarding tracker for each department and escalate delays to higher authorities. Monitoring Interact with the quality audit partner to log testing defects, track closure and confirm UAT sign-off before go-live. Bring out regular progress assessment reports, flagging deviations, delays and risks with proposed mitigation. Monitor live service health (uptime, API response time, transaction success rate, crash and error trends) through agreed dashboards/MIS, and report SLA breaches.
